speaker: (the neighbour)
text: Mistress Ansell. I will not come in. I have it from the lane, and I will say it on the step.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Say it on the step. I have the bar in my hand, and I am not opening the house to a story.

speaker: (the neighbour)
text: Apprentices went against the Counter in the Poultry. They took the prisoners out. That is what I was told.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Counter. The prisoners out. Did you see the door, or did you hear it?

speaker: (the neighbour)
text: I heard it. I did not go down to the Poultry to look at a door.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. I do not want a man of this close coming home with a tale he stood inside.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I was at the loom until the light went. I heard the shuttle. Then I heard the knock.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then this is the lane's news, at second hand, and not a thing any of us stood in.

speaker: (the neighbour)
text: The lane has it. I thought the mistress should have it before morning, rather than from a crier.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have it. Yesterday butter, today a prison. Mark me, they have left off asking.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Yesterday the butter was fourpence, and nobody argued with the crier. Today the step has a prison on it, and I was not there.

speaker: (the neighbour)
text: I am not here about a price. I am here because the other story reached the lane.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The lane has heard it. The lane is not going to look at it. You may go, and thank you for staying on the step.

speaker: (the neighbour)
text: I will go. I have no second errand, and I will not improve it on the way.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let him go, and bar it after. One telling is enough to keep.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will sit in. I have nowhere to take a story of this kind.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will sit in. So will the lodger. I am not sending anyone out to improve what the step already said.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not going. I have the stair, and I have no business at a prison door.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then go up. I have the street door. Mark me, I will still have it in the morning.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: If I am asked what I heard, I heard the mistress, and I heard a man on the step. I did not hear the Poultry.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the right size of it. Do not give it a number you were not told.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He was not told one. Nor was I. Up. Candles are yours, and a story on the step is not a reason to burn a second one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One candle. I am not sitting up to make them more than he said.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Barred. The close can talk to itself. This house is shut.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Then I am in my room. God give you a quiet stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you a quiet loom. I am going up.
